title: Git Diff Check: Catch What Your AI Agent Really Changed
description:
Your AI agent said it fixed a typo. What else did it touch? 🔍

✅ List changed files with git diff --name-only
✅ Approve each chunk with git add -p
✅ Commit only what you read

Day 5 of Safe AI Agents! Next up, Day 6: Spot Prompt Injection in a Repo File.
Follow for a new short every day and learn to lock down your AI coding agents.

#shorts #git #aicoding #aiagents #aisecurity #claudecode #programming
tags: check ai agent changes before commit
comment: Diff first or tests first: which would you run? Tell me in a word! Extra tip: git diff --staged shows exactly what is about to be committed, so run it right before git commit.
